temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Size Air fryer Pack says Fish bites or mini sticks 400°F / 205°C · 8 min 425°F / 220°C · 10 min Fish sticks or fish fingers 400°F / 205°C · 10 min 425°F / 220°C · 13 min Breaded or battered fillets 400°F / 205°C · 14 min 425°F / 220°C · 18 min Why the coating tears and the fish falls apart A fish stick is a block of flaky white fish held together only by its coating. In the air fryer the crumb sets and browns quickly on the side facing the fan, while the fish inside is still soft and the underside coating is still damp against the basket. Flip it too early and the soft underside stays stuck to the mesh, so the crumb tears away and the fish breaks. Flip it too roughly and the same thing happens. Wait until halfway, when the bottom has had time to firm up, then slide a thin spatula or tongs under each stick and turn it in one movement. Battered fillets are even more fragile than crumbed ones, so a light spray of oil on the basket helps them release. Worked example: a box of fish sticks A box of breaded fish sticks says 425°F for 13 minutes in the oven, turning once. In a basket air fryer that becomes 400°F for 10 minutes. Preheat 4 minutes, lay the sticks in one layer with a small gap between them, and turn them at 5 minutes. Fish bites need about 8 minutes; thick breaded fillets need about 14. If the box gives a fan-oven setting, 425°F for 13 minutes, the air fryer setting is the same. How to tell they are done The crumb should be golden and crisp on both sides, and the fish inside should be white, opaque and flake when you press it with a fork. A thermometer in the middle of the thickest piece should read 145°F (63°C). Pale crumb on the second side means a minute or two more; a stick that bends instead of holding straight is not hot through. Before they go in Cook straight from frozen; thawed fish sticks go soft and lose their coating. Spray the basket lightly, or use a perforated liner, so the crumb does not stick. Separate any sticks frozen together before they go in, because pulling them apart later tears the coating. Related presets Frozen fries 400°F · 15 min · shake ×2 Frozen chicken wings 390°F · 26 min · shake ×2 Frozen chicken breast 360°F · 24 min · flip at 12 425°F oven to air fryer, every food → Frozen pack converter → All food presets → Printable conversion chart → Frequently asked questions How long do fish sticks take in the air fryer? About 10 minutes at 400°F, turned at 5 minutes. Fish bites take about 8 minutes and breaded fillets about 14. Do I need to flip fish sticks? Yes, once at halfway, gently. Before then the underside is too soft to lift cleanly. Why does the coating stick to the basket? The bottom was still damp when it was turned, or the basket was dry. Spray it lightly and wait until halfway to flip. Do fish sticks need oil? Not on the fish; the coating is pre-fried. A little oil on the basket stops sticking. Can I cook battered fillets the same way? Yes, for about 14 minutes. Batter is softer than crumb, so use a liner and turn them with a wide spatula.
